theme: Primary-source amendment to early Indus marks, early Brahmi chronology and contact-period legends

With hypothetical moderate Perumbalai the range is 400–1,200 years. These measure inventory coverage. The first amendment’s 193 added specimens comprise 191 inscribed sherds/sealing and two motif-bearing objects without surviving script.
